title: Insurance Nerds Podcast:
description: Insurance Nerds Founder & Host Tony Canas interviews BlueMind founder Akil Balachandran to learn about how BlueMind offers everything an advisor needs.
html:
Akil Balachandran, Founder at BlueMind

Tony from Insurance Nerds chats with Akil Balachandran, Founder at BlueMind.App. It is a digital assistant tool beyond a CRM for financial advisors, enabling them to do better in front of clients. Everything an advisor needs at a glance on one elegant platform.
